code_block:
NotesApi:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Api
    Properties:
      # Name of the API in AWS console (includes environment for easy identification)
      # !Sub performs string substitution - replaces ${Environment} with actual value
      Name: !Sub 'd1-personal-note-api-${Environment}'
      
      # Stage name (e.g., dev, staging, prod) - becomes part of the URL
      # !Ref retrieves the value of the Environment parameter
      StageName: !Ref Environment
      
      # Enable AWS X-Ray tracing to track requests through your system
      TracingEnabled: true
      
      # CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) - allows web browsers to call this API
      # Without CORS, browsers block requests from different domains for security
      Cors:
        # HTTP methods that clients are allowed to use
        AllowMethods: "'GET,POST,PUT,DELETE,OPTIONS'"
        
        # HTTP headers that clients can include in requests
        AllowHeaders: "'Content-Type,Authorization'"
        
        # Which domains can call this API ('*' means all domains - use specific domains in production)
        AllowOrigin: "'*'"
      
      # Authentication and authorization configuration
      Auth:
        # By default, all API endpoints require Cognito authentication
        DefaultAuthorizer: CognitoAuthorizer
        
        # Define the authorizer that validates user tokens
        Authorizers:
          CognitoAuthorizer:
            # ARN (Amazon Resource Name) uniquely identifies the Cognito User Pool
            # !Sub builds the ARN by inserting the region, account ID, and pool ID
            UserPoolArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:cognito-idp:ap-southeast-1:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/${UserPoolId}'
            
            # Identity configuration
            Identity:
              # How long (in seconds) to cache authorization decisions (1 hour)
              # This reduces calls to Cognito and improves performance
              RevalidateEvery: 3600

      # TypeScript compiles to dist/ folder, so we point to the compiled JavaScript

      # Environment variables specific to this function

        Variables:
          # Name of the DynamoDB table to read from

      # Events that trigger this Lambda function

      Events:
        # Event 1: List all notes
        ListNotes:
          Type: Api
          Properties:
            RestApiId: !Ref NotesApi        # Which API Gateway this belongs to

WriteNotesFunction:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      # Unique name for this Lambda function
      FunctionName: !Sub 'd1-personal-note-write-${Environment}'
      
      # Location of the code (same as read function)
      CodeUri: .
      
      # Entry point for write operations
      Handler: dist/handlers/notes/writeHandler.handler
      
      # Environment variables for this function
      Environment:
        Variables:
          # DynamoDB table name for write operations
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref DynamoDBTableName
      
      # Events that trigger this Lambda function
      Events:
        # Event 1: OPTIONS request for /notes (CORS preflight)
        # Browsers send OPTIONS requests before POST/PUT/DELETE to check if they're allowed
        NotesOptions:
          Type: Api
          Properties:
            RestApiId: !Ref NotesApi
            Path: /notes
            Method: OPTIONS
            Auth:
              # No authentication required for OPTIONS (CORS preflight must be open)
              Authorizer: NONE
        
        # Event 2: Create a new note
        CreateNote:
          Type: Api
          Properties:
            RestApiId: !Ref NotesApi
            Path: /notes                     # POST to /notes creates a new note
            Method: POST
            # Auth is inherited from API Gateway default (Cognito required)
            # Result: POST /notes with JSON body → creates new note
        
        # Event 3: OPTIONS request for /notes/{id} (CORS preflight)
        NoteByIdOptions:
          Type: Api
          Properties:
            RestApiId: !Ref NotesApi
            Path: /notes/{id}
            Method: OPTIONS
            Auth:
              Authorizer: NONE
        
        # Event 4: Update an existing note
        UpdateNote:
          Type: Api
          Properties:
            RestApiId: !Ref NotesApi
            Path: /notes/{id}                # PUT to /notes/abc123 updates that note
            Method: PUT
            # Result: PUT /notes/abc123 with JSON body → updates note abc123
        
        # Event 5: Delete a note
        DeleteNote:
          Type: Api
          Properties:
            RestApiId: !Ref NotesApi
            Path: /notes/{id}                # DELETE to /notes/abc123 removes that note
            Method: DELETE
            # Result: DELETE /notes/abc123 → deletes note abc123
      
      # IAM Policies - this function needs full CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete)
      Policies:
        # Full DynamoDB access: PutItem, UpdateItem, DeleteItem, GetItem, Query
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy:
            TableName: !Ref DynamoDBTableName
        
        # CloudWatch monitoring permissions
        - CloudWatchLambdaInsightsExecutionRolePolicy
      
      # Tags for organization
      Tags:
        Environment: !Ref Environment
